entries.femaleVariant:
V. Lieutenant Mara Voss, NCPD.
I've been following your recent work. Impressive, though I doubt the department would approve of all your methods.
I have a proposition for you. Something I'd rather discuss in person.
I've sent you a location. Come alone, and keep this between us.
— Lt. Mara Voss

A contractor who helped make two witnesses disappear. I had enough evidence to bring him in. Unfortunately, the case was closed before my request for a warrant even reached a judge.

entries.femaleVariant: A few of us, yes. Unfortunately, being honest doesn't make you particularly influential in this department. The contractor is carrying an encrypted data shard. Transaction records, names, dates. Enough to connect him to the disappearances. I need that shard, V. But there's something else. I need you to eliminate him. Permanently. This isn't an arrest. I'm asking you to do wet work.
